final_message: I cleaned the data by removing duplicate order events based on the order id, keeping only the first occurrence of each order. I normalized the category names by trimming spaces and converting to lowercase. I parsed the placed_at timestamps to UTC to accurately identify orders placed in March 2024 UTC. I excluded orders with missing totals (-1) from revenue calculations. I then computed the total revenue and count of orders placed in March 2024 UTC, identified the top revenue category over the whole dataset, counted orders with missing totals, and counted duplicates removed. The results are saved in workspace/answer.json.
